claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageOnHitOperation.scope (caster_any_weapon_hit)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: DamageOnHitOperation currently fires 'when the caster hits a creature in the attachment scope' — the attachment IS the hit target (e.g., Hunter's Mark mark). Divine Favor has no specific target: the rider fires on any weapon attack hit by the caster regardless of target. Using self attachment produces a false on_hit_window label ('caster hits self') and routes the damage attaches_to edge to the caster rather than the hit creature. A scope field (or a new attachment kind) is needed to express 'caster-scoped: any weapon hit made by the caster' distinct from 'target-scoped: hit against the specific attached creature'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit."

discrepancies: no content/divine_favor.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
